info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Account Deletion API
info.description: The Settlement Account Deletion API allows consumers to remove existing settlement accounts from the system. This functionality is essential for maintaining accurate financial records and performance metrics. Typical users include financial administrators and compliance officers who require the ability to manage settlement accounts effectively to ensure data integrity and compliance. Implementing this API facilitates streamlined operations, ensuring that only valid settlement accounts are retained in the system.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific settlement account identified by its unique account number. Be cautious when performing this action as it may affect related transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send the necessary information required to delete a specific settlement account identified by its account number (ACC-200045). The request must include a JSON payload conforming to the defined schema.

204.description: The resource was deleted successfully and no content is returned.

DeleteSettlementAccountRequest.description: A string representing the request body for the DELETE operation on settlement account operations.

DeleteSettlementAccountResponse_204.title: Settlement Account Operations Response
DeleteSettlementAccountResponse_204.description: Response schema for deleting a settlement account operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Token mechanism for authorization. The token must be provided in the HTTP Authorization header, prefixed by the keyword 'Bearer'. The recommended token format is JSON Web Token (JWT).
